assumptions.label: Synthetic Cohort Scope
assumptions.description: Deterministic Monte Carlo sample representing diverse paternal age, metabolic markers, and lifestyle habits across the UAE.

assumptions.label: Historical Pathway Baseline
assumptions.description: Published clinical benchmark for male partner evaluation delay when entering fertility pathways without early triage.

assumptions.label: HAYAT Early Pathway
assumptions.description: Modelled clinical timeline achieved through Day-0 on-device factor identification and direct andrology referral guidance.

assumptions.label: Simulated Assessment Retention
assumptions.description: Modelled conversion across 6 steps reflecting anonymous, account-free UX and skip question support.

assumptions.label: Triage Action Adherence
assumptions.description: Modelled rate of users who take concrete follow-up actions (discreet booking, physician discussion, or self-care adjustment).

assumptions.label: Red-Flag Safety Rule Override
assumptions.description: Algorithmic safety contract: any detected acute symptom (torsion risk, rapid swelling, hematospermia) overrides directly to Urgent Assessment.

assumptions.label: Demographic Consistency Target
assumptions.description: Verification that rule engine logic applies identically across all age brackets and interface languages without systematic bias.
